question:
Solve the following 9x9 Futoshiki puzzle:

_   _   _   _   _   _   3 < _ < _
        ∧                   ∨   ∧
_ > _   _ > 1   9   _   7   3   6
        ∨                   ∧    
6   _   3 < _   _   8 > _   _ > 7
∨   ∧   ∨   ∨               ∨    
5   _   1   _   _   _   6 > _   8
∧   ∨                   ∨       ∨
_ > _ < 8   _   _   _   _ > _   2
∨   ∧   ∨       ∨                
_   _   _   5   2   1 < _   _   4
                                ∧
4   3   7 > _   8   _ > _ < _   _
            ∧       ∧       ∨   ∨
2   6   _ < 8   1   _   _   _   _
    ∨   ∧   ∨   ∧   ∨            
_   2   _   _   _ < _ < _ < 8 > 1

Ensure your answer follows the same format as the puzzle above, just replace blanks (_) with the correct value for the cell.
Use < and > for horizontal constraints. Use ∧ and ∨ for vertical constraints.
Remember, in Futoshiki each row and column must contain each number from 1 to 9 exactly once.

IMPORTANT: When you finish, put ONLY the final answer inside \boxed{...} (no extra text). If the task requests a multi-line format, encode it into a single line representation.

    s.add(cells[3][0] < cells[4][0])
    s.add(cells[3][1] > cells[4][1])
    s.add(cells[3][6] > cells[4][6])
    s.add(cells[3][8] > cells[4][8])

    # R4-R5:

    # Col 1: ∧ => cells[4][1] < cells[5][1]
    # Col 2: ∨ => cells[4][2] > cells[5][2]
    # Col 4: ∨ => cells[4][4] > cells[5][4]
    s.add(cells[4][0] > cells[5][0])
    s.add(cells[4][1] < cells[5][1])
    s.add(cells[4][2] > cells[5][2])
    s.add(cells[4][4] > cells[5][4])

    # R5-R6:
    # Col 8: ∧ => cells[5][8] < cells[6][8]
    s.add(cells[5][8] < cells[6][8])

    # R6-R7:
    # Col 3: ∧ => cells[6][3] < cells[7][3]
    # Col 5: ∧ => cells[6][5] < cells[7][5]
    # Col 7: ∨ => cells[6][7] > cells[7][7]
    # Col 8: ∨ => cells[6][8] > cells[7][8]
    s.add(cells[6][3] < cells[7][3])
    s.add(cells[6][5] < cells[7][5])
    s.add(cells[6][7] > cells[7][7])
    s.add(cells[6][8] > cells[7][8])

    # R7-R8:
    # Col 1: ∨ => cells[7][1] > cells[8][1]
    # Col 2: ∧ => cells[7][2] < cells[8][2]
    # Col 3: ∨ => cells[7][3] > cells[8][3]
    # Col 4: ∧ => cells[7][4] < cells[8][4]
    # Col 5: ∨ => cells[7][5] > cells[8][5]
    s.add(cells[7][1] > cells[8][1])
    s.add(cells[7][2] < cells[8][2])
    s.add(cells[7][3] > cells[8][3])
    s.add(cells[7][4] < cells[8][4])
    s.add(cells[7][5] > cells[8][5])

        return res
    else:
